notes: E-mess amount boxes now have - / + steppers (0.5 for fulka/katori/piece, 50 ml for liquids, 10 g for dry weights); you can still type any value. E-mess meal windows set to the real times (breakfast 7:30-10:00, lunch 12:30-14:00, snacks 16:30-18:00, dinner 19:30-21:00): reminders now nudge from each window's start and the meal picker offers a meal once its window has begun. E-mess meal entry is now one page: tick a dish and an amount box opens under it (fulka/katori in 0.5 steps, liquids in 50 ml, or type your own), with one time per meal at its heading. Fixed: mess-meal amounts now count toward the day's calories and show in What you ate. E-mess (IISc): Add-what-you-ate now has a Today's E-mess meal button that lists every meal whose time has already passed, lets you tick dishes across them, then set amount and time for each on one page. Plus the earlier Exercised enlarge/flip body map and the day's E-mess menu in meal reminders. Exercised flow: a search bar plus the front/back body map, with a new Enlarge view that shows one side at a time and a Flip button for precise muscle picking; the muscles you pick are named as you go. New E-mess (IISc) menu: a profile toggle that surfaces the day's E-mess breakfast/lunch/snacks/dinner in your meal reminders (each meal on its own, with an Exercised prompt), driven by the weekly rota; the whole menu stays searchable. Footer now links to the author's site and a contact email.
